findings.finding: Both are single-award economy choices, but their full arrival dates differ: J8 arrives in Bangkok on 2027-01-16 at 22:25 after 1,180 minutes; J14 arrives on 2027-01-17 at 09:50 after 1,175 minutes. Thus J8 reaches Bangkok on the earlier calendar date despite taking five minutes longer elapsed. J14 is the pool’s reported elapsed-time reference, not the earliest calendar-date arrival.

These separate-ticket choices match on reported route, full timestamps, duration (2,132 minutes), and transfer facts: SFO departs 2027-01-15 at 06:18 and BKK arrival is 2027-01-17 at 08:50. J101 is economy at 110,000 Turkish points; J43 is business at 275,000 Turkish points. The reported timing is not bought by upgrading: the same-schedule economy option exists. Both have unknown price scope, unconfirmed award traveler count and minimum-seat assessment, and unverified separate-ticket obligations. Matching schedules alone do not establish identical flights, booking facts, or availability.
